name: time-picker
title: Time Picker
description: Time input in three styles: iOS-style wheel drums whose rows tilt, shrink and fade past an inset selection band (scroll-driven on the native driver, momentum snapping, tap a row to jump); a Material 3-style clock face with a big hh : mm header, AM / PM toggle and a hand you drag anywhere on the dial — it snaps to hours, then crossfades to minutes; or a grid of bookable time chips with struck-through booked slots and Morning / Afternoon / Evening groups. Render any of them inline or as a floating-label field that opens it in a drag-to-dismiss sheet.
summary: A time picker as 3D wheel drums, a draggable clock dial or bookable time chips.
behavior: Wheel drums snap with momentum and a tapped row jumps into the band. On the clock, drag the hand anywhere on the dial; it snaps to hours, then moves on to minutes when you let go.
Wheel rows tilt, shrink and fade past the selection band, driven by scroll on the native driver; the clock header crossfades between hours and minutes.

Each wheel column and the clock dial are adjustable with increment / decrement actions; AM / PM and the time chips are radio groups, with booked or unavailable slots named. The sheet field is a button with expanded state.
props: Called when a wheel settles, the clock hand snaps or a chip is picked (or on Set when staged).
3D wheel drums, a grid of time slots, or an analog dial (24-hour mode adds an inner 13–00 ring).
Render in place, or as a field that opens a bottom sheet.
12-hour clock: an AM / PM column on the wheel, an AM / PM toggle on the clock.
Minute step for the wheel and the clock hand (the dial labels every 5); slot spacing for chips.
Used to pick 12h / 24h when hour12 is not set.
Chips: explicit slot list instead of start / end / interval.
Chips: taken slots, struck through and not selectable.
Chips: slots unavailable for another reason (faded).
Chips: Morning / Afternoon / Evening headings with an open-slot count.
Sheet: set to false to put the label above the field as static text (no notch) and show placeholder inside.
Sheet: shown while nothing is picked.
Sheet: field height and type size.
Sheet: stage the choice behind Cancel / Set; chips otherwise close on pick.
Sheet: red border, icon message and a shake.
Sheet: success border and check; a string is shown under the field.
Sheet: dims the field and blocks opening.
Selection band, clock hand and active segment, focus and halo colour.
Sheet: background behind the field (label notch).
Style for the wheel, clock, slot grid or field wrapper, depending on variant and presentation.

Sheet: the trigger box — background, border, radius, height, padding. Wins over the computed style; a borderColor replaces the resting border only (open, error and success colours still show). A numeric height / borderRadius re-centres the label and resizes the halo.
Sheet: the formatted time text in the trigger.

Sheet: label in both modes. color is the resting colour — open (accent), error and success still take over; fontSize sets the resting size, it floats at the same ratio and the notch follows its width.
Sheet: helper / error / success text. color applies to the helper; error and success keep their tone colour.
Sheet: placeholder colour in the trigger.
Sheet: clock icon colour at rest (accent while open).
Sheet: the sheet / dialog panel — background, border, radius, padding, shadow (transform and opacity are animated).
